answer: Each identity must lock 800 POA in a time-vault for 90 epochs. Every night a random auditor publishes a nonce; the owner must sign that nonce plus the vault outpoint, and peers verify that the signature and UTXO commitment mirror the registration record. A failed check burns the bond into a shared lagoon that pays honest jurors. Even a whisper of a reused vault or recycled key triggers an immediate slash. Creating N fake IDs therefore costs N times 800 POA plus 90 epochs of illiquid capital, which is linear and publicly checkable.
